title: Phase 10 Hex8/Tet10/Hex20 mesh builders
objective: Add benchmark-local structured block, cantilever, and Cook-style mesh builders for Hex8, Tet10, and Hex20.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E1 mesh utility scope, downstream unlocks, and acceptance criteria.

scope: Add structured block mesh builders for Hex8, Tet10, and Hex20.
Add cantilever mesh helpers with deterministic fixed/load boundary sets.
Add Cook-style mesh helpers including Tet10 support.
Validate generated meshes with P1-1 helpers.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact before editing any existing mesh-related symbol.
Implement Hex8 structured block generation using the new datamodel.
Implement Tet10 and Hex20 upgrades or native builders with positive orientation.
Implement cantilever and Cook-specific boundary tagging.
Add tests for topology counts, boundary sets, and positive quadrature Jacobians.
deliverables: Structured mesh builders for Phase 10 element families.
Cantilever and Cook mesh helper coverage.
Unit tests for counts, tags, and Jacobians.
acceptance_criteria: Hex8, Tet10, and Hex20 generated meshes have positive Jacobians at relevant quadrature points.
Boundary sets are deterministic and tested.

cases: Hex8 block mesh counts and Jacobians
Tet10 block mesh counts and Jacobians
Hex20 block mesh counts and Jacobians

risks: Higher-order mesh node ordering may mismatch element basis expectations; mitigate with quadrature Jacobian tests and small patch-style geometry checks.
completion_notes: Added structured Hex8, Tet10, and Hex20 mesh builders plus cantilever and Cook membrane helper meshes.
All generated meshes are validated with quadrature-point Jacobian checks and deterministic boundary aliases.
Gate C evidence: `uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_phase10_mesh_utils.py -v` -> 10/10 passed; ruff and mypy clean for touched Phase 1 Python files.
GitHub issue updates were skipped because `gh auth status` reported an invalid token.
